build_theta_method_matrix_equation: build the banded left-hand and right-hand side matrices for the theta method time-stepping scheme
compute_theta_method_block_residual: compute the vector residual between LHS and RHS of the theta method equation for core profiles
calculate_theta_method_block_loss: calculate the mean squared loss of the theta method residual for optimization
run_jaxopt_solver: run the jaxopt LBFGS solver to advance core profiles by one time step
solve_nonlinear_theta_method: solve the nonlinear theta method system using jaxopt optimization with configurable tolerance and max iterations
